2121462524281282700.en_summary: “Jensen has been incredibly good at retaining talent. There are very few high-profile departures from the NVIDIA executive team.” “This is probably when the sharks are in the water. The VCs are going to come in and offer people billions of dollars to start their own chip companies, their own neolabs.” “If a year from now we’ve seen a bunch of departures from NVIDIA, I’m going to be really concerned about their future.” “Steve Jobs is a pure visionary, and Jensen is negotiating every supply chain contract.” “If there’s any manufacturing issues with Rubin, people are distracted and Jensen’s not there. Things get solved slower, things get solved by committees.”
2121462524281282700.zh_summary: 「Jensen 在留住人才方面非常出色。NVIDIA 高管團隊很少有高調離職。」「這可能是鯊魚在水中的時候。VC 將進來向人們提供數十億美元來創辦自己的芯片公司、自己的新實驗室。」「如果一年後我們看到 NVIDIA 有大量離職，我將非常擔心他們的未來。」「Steve Jobs 是純粹的遠見者，而 Jensen 在談判每一份供應鏈合約。」「如果 Rubin 有任何製造問題，人們分心且 Jensen 不在。事情解決得更慢，由委員會解決。」

2121462139898806422.en_summary: Lol wtf, Tae Kim is a joke! He wrote an entire book about NVIDIA and Jensen. Jensen gave him his time, shared so many stories, and helped him with the book. He used to talk about “Jensen told me this, Jensen told me that,” almost like they were so close. Now, when Jensen is probably at the lowest point of his life, Kim comes out saying this. But where's the evidence? Has the investigation concluded? Has anyone publicly established exactly which rules Jensen broke and how? And since when does Tae Kim have the authority to declare that Jensen's career at NVIDIA is over for good? Are we pretending that every CEO and business leader out there has never broken a company rule or made a serious mistake? Does every violation automatically mean someone deserves to lose everything they spent their life building? I'm not saying Jensen did nothing wrong or that he should be above the rules. But where is the gratitude, the loyalty, or even a little compassion for someone who helped you? You can disagree with someone's actions without turning your back on them when they're down. Or maybe he's already trying to get on the good side of the next CEO, or whoever ends up holding power at NVIDIA. Who knows? Maybe it's just me, but I would never treat someone who helped me this way. Jensen doesn't even know me personally, let alone have helped me directly. But I've benefited enormously from his hard work, and I'll always be grateful for what he's built and contributed to the world. Maybe this dude never really made much money from his own investing. I don't know his portfolio or net worth. But if he was that good at understanding NVIDIA, you'd think he would have owned enough NVDA shares over the years to become very wealthy by now. And if he had personally benefited that much from Jensen's hard work, maybe he'd have a lot more appreciation for the man and what he's built. Just my thoughts. To me, it's just basic human decency. When you've benefited so much from someone's work, you don't simply forget everything they've done for you when they're at their lowest point.
2121462139898806422.zh_summary: Lol wtf，Tae Kim 是個笑話！他寫了一整本書關於 NVIDIA 和 Jensen。Jensen 給了他時間，分享了許多故事，並幫助他寫書。他以前談論「Jensen 告訴我這個，Jensen 告訴我那個」，幾乎像他們很親密。現在，當 Jensen 可能處於人生最低點時，Kim 出來這樣說。但證據在哪裡？調查結束了嗎？有人公開確立 Jensen 到底違反了哪些規則以及如何違反嗎？Tae Kim 什麼時候有權宣布 Jensen 在 NVIDIA 的職業永遠結束？我們是否假裝每個 CEO 和商業領袖從未違反公司規則或犯過嚴重錯誤？每一次違規都自動意味著某人應該失去他們一生建立的一切嗎？我不是說 Jensen 什麼都沒做錯，或者他應該凌駕於規則之上。但對於幫助過你的人，感恩、忠誠甚至一點同情在哪裡？你可以不同意某人的行為，而不在他們低落時背棄他們。或者也許他已經在試圖討好下任 CEO，或者最終在 NVIDIA 掌握權力的人。誰知道呢？也許只是我，但我永遠不會這樣對待幫助過我的人。Jensen 甚至不認識我個人，更不用說直接幫助過我。但我從他的努力中受益匪淺，我將永遠感激他建立和貢獻給世界的東西。也許這傢伙從未從自己的投資中賺很多錢。我不知道他的投資組合或淨值。但如果他那麼擅長理解 NVIDIA，你會認為他多年來擁有足夠的 NVDA 股份成為非常富有。如果他從 Jensen 的努力中個人受益那麼多，也許他會對這個人和他建立的東西有更多感激。只是我的想法。對我來說，這只是基本的人性和體面。當你從某人的工作中受益這麼多時，你不會在他們最低點時簡單忘記他們為你做的一切。
